001package com.streamconverter.command.impl.xml;
002
003import com.streamconverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamconverter.command.rule.IRule;
005import com.streamconverter.path.TreePath;
006import com.streamconverter.security.SecureXmlConfiguration;
007import java.io.IOException;
008import java.io.InputStream;
009import java.io.OutputStream;
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011import java.util.List;
012import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventFactory;
013import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventReader;
014import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventWriter;
015import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
016import javax.xml.stream.XMLOutputFactory;
017import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
018import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
019import org.slf4j.Logger;
020import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
021
022/**
023 * XML Navigate Command for applying transformations to XML data.
024 *
025 * <p>This command navigates through XML structures and applies transformations using rules while
026 * preserving the overall XML structure. It identifies specific elements using TreePath
027 * slash-delimited path expressions (e.g., {@code product/name}) and applies {@link IRule}
028 * transformations to the text content of matching nodes.
029 *
030 * <p>The full XML event stream — including the XML declaration, all elements, attributes, and text
031 * nodes — is written to the output. Only character data at nodes whose path exactly matches the
032 * configured {@link TreePath} is transformed by the rule; all other events are passed through
033 * unchanged.
034 */
035public class XmlNavigateCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
036  private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(XmlNavigateCommand.class);
037  private static final XMLEventFactory EVENT_FACTORY = XMLEventFactory.newInstance();
038
039  private final TreePath treePath;
040  private final IRule rule;
041
042  /**
043   * Constructor for XML navigation with TreePath selector and transformation rule.
044   *
045   * @param treePath the TreePath to select elements
046   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
047   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
048   */
049  private XmlNavigateCommand(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
050    this.treePath = treePath;
051    this.rule = rule;
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Factory method for creating an XML navigation command with TreePath and rule.
056   *
057   * @param treePath the TreePath to select elements
058   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
059   * @return an XmlNavigateCommand that transforms the specified TreePath elements with the given
060   *     rule
061   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
062   */
063  public static XmlNavigateCommand create(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
064    if (treePath == null) {
065      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
066    }
067    if (rule == null) {
068      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
069    }
070    return new XmlNavigateCommand(treePath, rule);
071  }
072
073  @Override
074  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
075    XMLEventReader eventReader = null;
076    XMLEventWriter eventWriter = null;
077    IOException primaryException = null;
078
079    try {
080      eventReader = createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
081      eventWriter = createXMLEventWriter(outputStream);
082      navigateXmlWithRule(eventReader, eventWriter, treePath, rule);
083      eventWriter.flush();
084    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
085      primaryException = buildXmlException(e);
086      throw primaryException;
087    } finally {
088      closeResources(eventReader, eventWriter, primaryException);
089    }
090  }
091
092  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
093  // IRule.apply() declares no checked exceptions; any RuntimeException must be caught and
094  // re-thrown as XMLStreamException so the caller's error-handling path is not bypassed.
095  private void navigateXmlWithRule(
096      XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter, TreePath treePath, IRule rule)
097      throws XMLStreamException {
098    List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
099
100    while (eventReader.hasNext()) {
101      XMLEvent event = eventReader.nextEvent();
102
103      if (event.isStartElement()) {
104        currentPath.add(event.asStartElement().getName().getLocalPart());
105      } else if (event.isEndElement()) {
106        if (currentPath.isEmpty()) {
107          LOGGER.warn(
108              "Unexpected end element '{}' with empty path stack — possible malformed XML",
109              event.asEndElement().getName().getLocalPart());
110        } else {
111          currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
112        }
113      } else if (event.isCharacters() && treePath.matches(currentPath)) {
114        String data = event.asCharacters().getData();
115        String transformed;
116        try {
117          transformed = rule.apply(data);
118        } catch (RuntimeException ruleEx) {
119          throw new XMLStreamException("Rule application failed at path " + currentPath, ruleEx);
120        }
121        // Write every event unconditionally; character events at the target path are replaced
122        // above.
123        event = EVENT_FACTORY.createCharacters(transformed);
124      }
125
126      eventWriter.add(event);
127    }
128  }
129
130  private XMLEventReader createXMLEventReader(InputStream inputStream) throws XMLStreamException {
131    XMLInputFactory inputFactory = SecureXmlConfiguration.createSecureXMLInputFactory();
132    XMLEventReader reader = inputFactory.createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
133    if (!reader.hasNext()) {
134      try {
135        reader.close();
136      } catch (XMLStreamException closeEx) {
137        LOGGER.warn("Failed to close empty XMLEventReader", closeEx);
138      }
139      throw new XMLStreamException("Empty XML input");
140    }
141    return reader;
142  }
143
144  private XMLEventWriter createXMLEventWriter(OutputStream outputStream) throws XMLStreamException {
145    XMLOutputFactory outputFactory = XMLOutputFactory.newInstance();
146    return outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(outputStream);
147  }
148
149  private IOException buildXmlException(XMLStreamException e) {
150    String location = "";
151    if (e.getLocation() != null) {
152      int line = e.getLocation().getLineNumber();
153      int column = e.getLocation().getColumnNumber();
154      if (line > 0 && column > 0) {
155        location = String.format(" at line %d, column %d", line, column);
156      }
157    }
158    LOGGER.error("XML processing failed{}", location, e);
159    return new IOException("XML processing failed" + location, e);
160  }
161
162  private void closeResources(
163      XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter, IOException primaryException) {
164    flushAndCloseWriter(eventWriter, primaryException);
165    closeEventReader(eventReader, primaryException);
166  }
167
168  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
169  private void flushAndCloseWriter(XMLEventWriter eventWriter, IOException primaryException) {
170    // RuntimeException from XMLEventWriter.close() is not declared; catch is required to
171    // suppress it into primaryException so the caller's original failure is preserved.
172    if (eventWriter == null) {
173      return;
174    }
175    try {
176      eventWriter.flush();
177    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
178      LOGGER.warn("Failed to flush XMLEventWriter during cleanup", e);
179    }
180    try {
181      eventWriter.close();
182    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
183      LOGGER.warn("Failed to close XMLEventWriter", e);
184    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
185      if (primaryException != null) {
186        primaryException.addSuppressed(e);
187      } else {
188        throw e;
189      }
190    }
191  }
192
193  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
194  private void closeEventReader(XMLEventReader eventReader, IOException primaryException) {
195    // RuntimeException from XMLEventReader.close() is not declared; catch is required to
196    // suppress it into primaryException so the caller's original failure is preserved.
197    if (eventReader == null) {
198      return;
199    }
200    try {
201      eventReader.close();
202    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
203      LOGGER.warn("Failed to close XMLEventReader", e);
204    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
205      if (primaryException != null) {
206        primaryException.addSuppressed(e);
207      } else {
208        throw e;
209      }
210    }
211  }
212}
